source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_8/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_8_0 and Source5_8_1 on school_name (inner join to keep only matching schools)

# Group by school_name and sum math_score

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
